business_process: Safety instrumented functions and chlorine gas detection at Plant C1
description: SIS trips for chlorine car isolation, reactor high temperature and feed ratio, scrubber, and peroxide tank temperature; 38 chlorine detectors alarmed in the control room and at the ERC
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Up to 360,000 lb of chlorine stays connected to the unloading manifold even when production stops. Without the SIS and detection, the cars must be isolated by hand and the site moved to its emergency posture. RPO is the approved SIS program copy, which changes only through MOC
manual_workaround: Manual isolation of the chlorine cars from the unloading platform; portable chlorine monitors; fire watch; production held
dependent_people_or_facilities: Plant C1 shift superintendent; I&E technicians; plant hazardous materials team
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Runs on its own network and power; does not depend on any group service. Gas alarms also repeat to the Group ERC (BP-G06)

business_process: Release notification and emergency response coordination
description: Calls to 911 and county fire rescue, the National Response Center, the SERC and LEPC, and community warning for an accidental release at any plant (RMP 68.95 at Plant C1; 68.90(b) at Program 2 plants)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Release notices are immediate (40 CFR 302.6; 355.43(a)). The community notification system must work when the business network and VoIP phones are down. RPO covers the call lists, which change monthly
manual_workaround: Cellular phones, satellite phone, and printed call lists in each control room and gatehouse; plant radio to the gate
dependent_systems: Plant cellular phones; community notification service
dependent_third_parties: County emergency management; community notification vendor; carriers
dependent_people_or_facilities: Plant managers; EHS staff; shift superintendents
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Independent of SYS-G1 to SYS-G5 by design. The Group ERC (BP-G06) is the backup caller

business_process: Emergency response telephone service (Group ERC)
description: 24x7 emergency response number on all group shipping papers (49 CFR 172.604) and the group crisis line; responders read product hazard data from SYS-G7
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: 172.604(a)(1) requires the number to be monitored at all times while any group hazmat shipment is in transportation (about 1,100 loaded movements a day). A call-back service does not meet the rule. RPO covers product hazard data in SYS-G7
manual_workaround: Automatic call routing to the backup ERC site; printed response guides and offline SDS copies for the top 500 products
dependent_systems: SYS-G7 (ERC console and SDS data); telephony
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All three divisions name the Group ERC on their shipping papers; carriers and first responders call it for every group shipment

business_process: Workforce identity and access
description: Sign-in, MFA, PAM, and identity governance for about 45,000 workforce users (SYS-G1)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Every IT application federates to SYS-G1. Plant control rooms keep local DCS accounts and do not need SYS-G1 to run
manual_workaround: Sealed break-glass accounts for each critical system; local OT accounts; cached credentials on ERP shipping terminals
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Used by every IT process below; OT remote access (BP-G02) also depends on it

business_process: Cloud landing zones, WAN, and site connectivity
description: Network hub, guardrails, keys, and logging in providers A and B; WAN links to 16 plants, 64 branches, 3 terminals, and 28 truck terminals (SYS-G3)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: SYS-D3 telemetry, SYS-T1 dispatch, and ERP integration services run behind the hubs; branches and truck terminals reach ERP over the WAN
manual_workaround: Cellular failover at every branch and truck terminal; plants run locally without the WAN
dependent_third_parties: Cloud providers A and B; carriers
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Managed inventory service, dispatch, ERP, data platform

business_process: Security monitoring, incident response, and the OT desk
description: 24x7 SOC, SIEM, EDR, and the OT monitoring console for 9 plants and Terminal T1 (SYS-G2)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Notification clocks (Form 8-K Item 1.05; 33 CFR 6.16-1; state breach laws) keep running during an outage; OT anomaly detection protects the safety-relevant plants
manual_workaround: Forensic retainer tooling; EDR console reachable from provider B; plant operators watch for process anomalies
dependent_third_parties: SIEM and EDR vendors; forensic retainer
dependent_people_or_facilities: SOC analysts; OT desk engineers; division liaisons
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Every division depends on the SOC to establish incident facts

business_process: En route security monitoring of hazmat loads
description: Geofence, stop-time, and panic alerts from tractors and cargo tanks carrying hydrogen peroxide (Division 5.1) and Class 3 solvents; dispatch check calls (security plan, 49 CFR 172.802(a)(3))
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The carrier security plan relies on telematics alerts for en route security of large bulk quantities. Without them, a theft or diversion of a loaded cargo tank may not be noticed for hours
manual_workaround: Driver check calls every 2 hours by cellular phone for security plan loads; loads of 5.1 and Class 3 PG II held at terminals beyond 4 hours of outage
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Shipments offered by Specialty Chemicals and Distribution (about 55% of their bulk outbound loads)

business_process: Plant C1 chlorine unloading and hypochlorite production
description: DCS control of chlorine unloading, both hypochlorite reactor trains, and the blend halls; about 900 tons a day (SYS-C1)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 60% of Plant C1 hypochlorite goes to Southeast water utilities that hold 7 to 14 days of supply. The SIS keeps the unit safe if the DCS stops, so the limit is supply, not safety. RPO: setpoints, alarm limits, and logic restore from the last approved configuration; batch data loses at most 1 hour
manual_workaround: Reactors shut down safely; two other plants and Terminal T1 inventory cover priority utility orders for about 5 days
dependent_people_or_facilities: Plant C1 operators (4 shifts); Controls Engineering
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Shares outbound capacity with Hazmat Transport (BP-HT01); relies on SYS-C8 for clean configuration copies

business_process: Plant C1 tank farm, loading rack, and outbound shipping
description: Tank gauging, transfer pumps, and the truck loading rack (46 PLCs, SYS-C4) with order release from ERP
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 140 truckloads a day; water utility orders cannot wait beyond their storage. Shipping papers must be accurate before any load leaves (49 CFR 172.200 series)
manual_workaround: Manual loading with two-person verification and pre-printed shipping papers for the 40 bulk products shipped from Plant C1
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Hazmat Transport carries about 55% of the loads; shipping papers come from ERP (BP-G05)

business_process: Managed inventory service (tank telemetry and automatic replenishment)
description: Telemetry from about 2,600 customer tanks, demand forecasts, and automatic orders; about 640 sites are water or wastewater utilities (SYS-D3)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Utilities rely on automatic replenishment of hypochlorite and other treatment chemicals. A tank that runs dry stops disinfection. The 12 largest customers expect a SOC 2 Type 2 report (P09)
manual_workaround: Customer service calls the 640 utility sites daily for manual tank readings; orders keyed by hand in ERP
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Orders flow to Specialty Chemicals plants and are carried by Hazmat Transport

business_process: Terminal T1 marine transfers and bulk tank storage
description: Tank gauging, pump and valve control, and marine transfer controls for 42 tanks (about 38 million gallons) at 2 ship berths and 1 barge dock (SYS-D1)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Vessel demurrage and berth schedules; independent high-level alarms keep tanks safe if gauging fails. MTSA Facility Security Plan measures must continue (33 CFR Part 105)
manual_workaround: Manual tank dips; transfers stopped; vessels held at anchor
dependent_third_parties: Gauging and PLC vendors; vessel agents
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Receives caustic soda and solvents that Specialty Chemicals plants use as raw materials

business_process: Terminal T1 truck and rail loading racks
description: Loading rack automation and the terminal management system for about 220 truckloads and 15 railcars a day (SYS-D1)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customer deliveries and plant raw materials; bill of lading and shipping papers produced at the rack
manual_workaround: Manual loading with meter tickets and pre-printed shipping papers; reduced to about 60 loads a day
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: About 30% of loads go to Specialty Chemicals plants as raw materials

business_process: ERP order-to-cash, inventory, and hazmat shipping paper data
description: Orders, inventory (including chemical-of-interest tracking), maintenance work orders, and the product data used to print shipping papers for all three divisions (SYS-G4)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Every division ships from ERP data. Shipping papers must carry the correct description and the emergency response number before a hazmat load moves
manual_workaround: Pre-printed shipping papers for the top 500 products; orders by phone and spreadsheet; inventory by physical count
dependent_third_parties: ERP SaaS integration vendor; EDI partners
dependent_people_or_facilities: ERP support; customer service in all divisions
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Single dependency for shipping papers in all three divisions (P08 scenario)

business_process: Dispatch, load planning, and electronic shipping papers
description: Dispatch of about 1,900 tractors, load planning, electronic shipping papers on driver tablets, and printed copies at pickup (SYS-T1)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Drivers cannot accept hazmat loads without shipping papers; Specialty Chemicals and Distribution depend on the carrier for about 55% of bulk loads
manual_workaround: Phone dispatch from terminals; paper shipping papers from the shipper; printed load sheets
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Customers and the two sister divisions; ERP product data feeds shipping papers

business_process: Production at the other 15 Specialty Chemicals plants
description: Batch and continuous production at 8 plants on the OT standard and 7 legacy plants, including 4 Program 2 ammonia plants (SYS-C6)
process_owner: Specialty Chemicals Vice President of Manufacturing Technology
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Division revenue (about $31.2 million a day across 16 plants) and customer supply. The 7 legacy plants have no tested OT backups, so their RTO is unproven
manual_workaround: Shift production to sister plants with spare capacity (about 20%); safe shutdown under each plant procedure
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Raw materials from Terminal T1; outbound loads on Hazmat Transport; configuration copies from SYS-C8

business_process: Batch execution and recipe management
description: Batch management at Plant C1 for about 2,300 master recipes, synchronized from the division recipe library in SYS-C8 (SYS-C2)
process_owner: Specialty Chemicals Director of Process Control Engineering
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Blended products cannot be made without verified recipes. An altered recipe can create an incompatible mixture, so restore only from a verified library copy
manual_workaround: Run hypochlorite and the top 50 blends from printed, signed recipe sheets with two-person verification
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Recipe library is central (SYS-C8) and pushes to all plants

business_process: Terminal T1 access control and CCTV
description: TWIC readers, gate control, and CCTV required by the Facility Security Plan (SYS-D4)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: MTSA access control under the Facility Security Plan must continue (33 CFR 105.255); reader records are SSI
manual_workaround: Guards inspect TWICs visually and log entries by hand; extra patrols
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: None

business_process: Branch warehousing, repackaging, and order fulfillment
description: 64 branches: receiving, drum and tote repackaging (line PLCs), picking, and shipping (SYS-D2)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $15.3 million a day of third-party sales; customers hold several days of stock
manual_workaround: Paper pick lists and manual repackaging records at branches with cellular failover
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: ERP (BP-G05); Hazmat Transport for deliveries

business_process: Hours of service and ELD records
description: Electronic logging devices and fleet telematics for about 2,700 drivers (SYS-T2)
process_owner: Hazmat Transport Director of Fleet Technology
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: If an ELD malfunctions, drivers keep paper logs and the carrier must correct the malfunction within 8 days (49 CFR 395.34). Fleet-wide paper logging is possible but slow to audit
manual_workaround: Paper graph-grid logs per 395.34(a); reconstruct the prior 7 days
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: None

business_process: Email, files, and chat
description: Productivity suite for all workforce (SYS-G5)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customer communication and coordination; not used for control or release notification
manual_workaround: Mobile phones; division call trees
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All divisions

business_process: Quality release and certificates of analysis
description: LIMS for all 16 plants; certificates of analysis for each shipment (SYS-C7)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Utilities and food customers require a certificate of analysis with each load
manual_workaround: Paper lab sheets and manually signed certificates for priority customers
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Certificates feed the Distribution customer portal (BP-DS05)

business_process: Customer portal (orders, SDS, certificates)
description: Customer self-service portal on the managed inventory platform (SYS-D3)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: SDS access for customers is also available from the ERC and by email
manual_workaround: Customer service sends SDS and certificates by email
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SDS from SYS-G7; certificates from SYS-C7

business_process: Customer load tracking and freight billing
description: Load status for about 1,400 third-party shippers and billing (SYS-T1)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Revenue (about $2.7 million a day from third parties) can be billed late without loss
manual_workaround: Status by phone; billing batched after recovery
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Intercompany billing to Specialty Chemicals and Distribution

business_process: Central process control engineering and configuration repositories
description: Engineering workstations, configuration and recipe repositories, and the DCS backup server at the division engineering center (SYS-C8)
process_owner: Specialty Chemicals Director of Process Control Engineering
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Plants run without the hub, but clean configuration copies for a cyber restore come from it. It is also a path into every plant (P01 SC-002)
manual_workaround: Plant-held offline copies (Plant C1 and the 8 OT-standard plants); engineers work on site
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Every plant restore depends on it; reaches plants through the OT remote access gateway (BP-G02)

business_process: Process historian and OT DMZ at Plant C1
description: Historian, replica broker, and OT DMZ services (SYS-C5)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Gas detection and SIS trip records support RMP incident investigation (68.81) and release reports; production does not need the historian
manual_workaround: DCS keeps 30 days of trends locally; event journals exported by hand
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Feeds the group data platform (BP-G08) and AI-001 (BP-SC10)

business_process: Product stewardship and SDS authoring
description: Product hazard data and SDS for about 11,000 products (SYS-G7 authoring)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: New products and SDS revisions can wait; the ERC uses the read-only copy (BP-G06)
manual_workaround: Offline SDS library; new product launches held
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Feeds shipping paper data in ERP and the ERC

business_process: Fleet maintenance and cargo tank inspection records
description: Maintenance and cargo tank test and inspection records (SYS-T4)
process_owner: Hazmat Transport Vice President of Safety and Compliance
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A cargo tank with an overdue test cannot be loaded; records must be producible at inspection
manual_workaround: Paper inspection records at each terminal wash rack and shop
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: None

business_process: OT remote access gateway
description: Vendor, integrator, and central engineering sessions into the OT DMZs of 16 plants and Terminal T1 (SYS-G1 gateway)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Plants and Terminal T1 run without remote access. Integrators come on site for urgent work. Its value is support speed, not uptime. Its risk is the opposite (P01 GR-01)
manual_workaround: Integrators and engineers work on site under escort
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Specialty Chemicals plants and Terminal T1; central engineering hub (BP-SC08)

business_process: Financial close and SEC reporting
description: Close, consolidation, and SEC reporting
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Quarterly and annual filing deadlines
manual_workaround: Close calendar shifted within filing deadlines
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Consolidates all divisions

business_process: Payroll and HR
description: Payroll and HR for about 45,000 workforce members (SYS-G4 HR and payroll SaaS)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Pay dates; payroll can be repeated from the prior cycle
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll; manual adjustments after recovery
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All divisions

business_process: Driver qualification and drug and alcohol testing records
description: Driver qualification files and testing records for about 2,700 current and 1,900 former drivers (SYS-T3)
process_owner: Hazmat Transport Vice President of Safety and Compliance
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Records must be produced at audits (49 CFR 391.51); no daily operation depends on them
manual_workaround: Paper qualification checklist for new hires; audits rescheduled
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: None

business_process: Group data platform and process analytics
description: Historian replicas, process analytics, and the machine learning workspace (SYS-G6)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Analytics and AI training only; no real-time operations depend on it
manual_workaround: Plants use local historian trends
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Trains AI-001; reads plant historian replicas

business_process: AI-001 process-optimization advisory
description: Recommended caustic feed ratio and temperature setpoints for the Plant C1 hypochlorite reactors (SYS-C9), advisory only since 2026-09-03
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Operators run the reactors without it under normal operating procedures
manual_workaround: Normal operating procedures; no change in setpoints
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Depends on the historian replica (BP-SC06) and the data platform (BP-G08)
